title: vendorkb
description: vendorkb: what runs now, the pipeline, users' questions and the database.

panels.title: MCP up
panels.description: Is the vendorkb-app target up, and the version it runs.

panels.title: Running now
panels.description: Task runs with a live heartbeat, and runs whose heartbeat is stale.

panels.title: Last sync
panels.description: Time since the last successful sync, and since the delta feed cursor last moved.

panels.title: Failed in 24 h

targets.expr: count((max by (job_name) (kube_job_status_failed{namespace="vendorkb"}) > 0) and on (job_name) (time() - max by (job_name) (kube_job_status_start_time{namespace="vendorkb"}) < 86400)) or vector(0)

panels.description: Failed Kubernetes Jobs started in the last 24 h (vendorkb namespace), and task kinds (per stage) whose last failure is in the last 24 h.

panels.title: Questions in 24 h
panels.description: answer_question calls by users (evals excluded; gather_evidence parts are not counted as questions), and their p95 duration.

panels.title: Spend
panels.description: Pipeline spend (leaf task runs started in the window) plus the answer model's cost for users' questions.

panels.title: Running and stalled tasks

targets.expr: max by (kind, stage, run, origin, state) (label_replace(vendorkb_task_running, "state", "running", "", "") or label_replace(vendorkb_task_stalled, "state", "stalled", "", ""))

(vendorkb_task_done) * on (kind, stage, run) group_left (origin, state) max by (kind, stage, run, origin, state) (label_replace(vendorkb_task_running, "state", "running", "", "") or label_replace(vendorkb_task_stalled, "state", "stalled", "", ""))

(vendorkb_task_total) * on (kind, stage, run) group_left (origin, state) max by (kind, stage, run, origin, state) (label_replace(vendorkb_task_running, "state", "running", "", "") or label_replace(vendorkb_task_stalled, "state", "stalled", "", ""))

(100 * vendorkb_task_done / (vendorkb_task_total > 0)) * on (kind, stage, run) group_left (origin, state) max by (kind, stage, run, origin, state) (label_replace(vendorkb_task_running, "state", "running", "", "") or label_replace(vendorkb_task_stalled, "state", "stalled", "", ""))

(deriv(vendorkb_task_done[15m]) * 60) * on (kind, stage, run) group_left (origin, state) max by (kind, stage, run, origin, state) (label_replace(vendorkb_task_running, "state", "running", "", "") or label_replace(vendorkb_task_stalled, "state", "stalled", "", ""))

(((vendorkb_task_total - vendorkb_task_done) / (deriv(vendorkb_task_done[15m]) > 0)) or (vendorkb_task_done * 0 - 1)) * on (kind, stage, run) group_left (origin, state) max by (kind, stage, run, origin, state) (label_replace(vendorkb_task_running, "state", "running", "", "") or label_replace(vendorkb_task_stalled, "state", "stalled", "", ""))

(vendorkb_task_spent_usd) * on (kind, stage, run) group_left (origin, state) max by (kind, stage, run, origin, state) (label_replace(vendorkb_task_running, "state", "running", "", "") or label_replace(vendorkb_task_stalled, "state", "stalled", "", ""))

panels.description: One row per running task run. Rate is items per minute over 15 min; time left is shown only while the rate is above 0, else unknown.
